annotation.bound_parties_text: The measures bind pilot-operation entities (道路应用试点主体) running autonomous vehicles in road application pilots, who must have vehicles tested and file reports, and the testing institutions that must carry out the inspections.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: 道路应用试点主体定期完成安全检测的，应当将以下材料提交市交通运输部门、北京经济技术开发区管委会
annotation.dates_quote: 第十一条【实施日期】本办法自印发之日起实施。
annotation.robot_provision_quote: 北京市自动驾驶汽车道路应用试点车辆安全检测办法（试行）
